test_title: PYST 64: RRB Group D - GS (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the two statements given below and choose the correct option.

Statement A: Acids react with all metals to form hydrogen gas.

Statement B: Gold and platinum also react with acids to release hydrogen.

options.text: Statement A is correct but B is incorrect.
Statement A is incorrect but B is correct.
Both statements A and B are correct.
Both statements A and B are incorrect.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both statements A and B are incorrect**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement A** asserts that acids react with all metals to form hydrogen gas. This statement is **incorrect** because only metals that are positioned above **Hydrogen** in the **Reactivity Series** can displace hydrogen from dilute acids.
 
• Metals such as **Copper**, **Mercury**, **Silver**, **Gold**, and **Platinum** are less reactive than hydrogen and do not react with dilute **Hydrochloric Acid** (HCl) or dilute **Sulphuric Acid** (H2SO4) to liberate **Hydrogen gas**. ***Hence, statement A is incorrect.***
 
• **Statement B** claims that **Gold** and **Platinum** react with acids to release hydrogen. This statement is **incorrect** because these are classified as **Noble Metals**.
 
• **Gold** and **Platinum** are at the very bottom of the **Reactivity Series**, meaning they are chemically inert under normal conditions and do not react with common mineral acids to release any gas
